# dodopayments_product_localized_prices (Data Source)

Lists product localized prices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_addon" "example" {
  currency     = "USD"
  name         = "example-addon"
  price        = 100
  tax_category = "digital_products"
}

resource "dodopayments_credit_entitlement" "example" {
  currency         = "USD"
  name             = "example-credit-entitlement"
  overage_enabled  = false
  precision        = 2
  price_per_unit   = "10.5"
  rollover_enabled = false
  unit             = "credits"
}

resource "dodopayments_entitlement" "example" {
  integration_config = {
    feature_id   = "example-entitlement"
    feature_type = "boolean"
  }
  integration_type = "feature_flag"
  metadata = {
    tier = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-entitlement"
}

resource "dodopayments_product" "example" {
  addons = [dodopayments_addon.example.id]
  credit_entitlements = [{
    credit_entitlement_id = dodopayments_credit_entitlement.example.id
    credits_amount        = "100.0"
  }]
  entitlements = [{
    entitlement_id = dodopayments_entitlement.example.id
  }]
  metadata = {
    plan = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-product"
  price = {
    type                         = "recurring_price"
    currency                     = "USD"
    price                        = 1000
    payment_frequency_count      = 1
    payment_frequency_interval   = "Month"
    subscription_period_count    = 1
    subscription_period_interval = "Year"
  }
  pricing_mode = "by_currency"
  tax_category = "saas"
}

resource "dodopayments_product_localized_price" "example" {
  amount     = 900
  currency   = "EUR"
  product_id = dodopayments_product.example.id
}

data "dodopayments_product_localized_prices" "example" {
  product_id = dodopayments_product_localized_price.example.product_id
  max_items  = 10
}

output "product_localized_prices" {
  value = data.dodopayments_product_localized_prices.example.items
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (String) The ID of the product.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. The default is 1000.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The product localized prices that the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents).
- `country_code` (String) Country the rule applies to. Only set when mode is by_country.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the localized price was created.
- `currency` (String) Currency to charge in.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the localized price.
- `mode` (String) Pricing mode of the rule: by_currency or by_country.
- `product_id` (String) Product this localized price belongs to.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the localized price was last updated.
